services.name: Lake Tombigbee Campground
services.desc: The Lake Tombigbee Campground is an enterprise of the Alabama-Coushatta Tribe of Texas. Located on Lake Tombigbee, our campground is the perfect fun and affordable weekend getaway. Bring your family and friends - we have RV sites with full hookups, primitive and luxury tent sites, and a variety of cabins to accommodate any size family or group on our beautiful 26-acre campground surrounding (the fully stocked) Lake Tombigbee. blurb: Located an hour and a half north of Houston in the Big Thicket, the Alabama-Coushatta Tribe is the oldest Indian reservation in Texas. Our rich history and beautiful enclave are what tribal citizens and tourists alike love about our nation.
